Utilizar conhecimento e experiência para vender aos consumidores, atendê-los e alcançar excelência operacional, além de executar operações de loja perfeitamente quando for responsável pelo fluxo de produtos entre a área de vendas, o estoque e/ou o caixa, seguindo os procedimentos.

Principais Responsabilidades:

• Apoiar as operações de vendas da loja e os funcionários como terceiro responsável, cumprindo a função de gerente responsável na ausência do Store Manager e do Assistant Store Manager para assegurar o gerenciamento e a supervisão da loja, garantindo o cumprimento dos padrões de atendimento da adidas.

• Colaborar na obtenção dos KPIs da loja e garantir que a equipe tenha ciência deles e da forma como contribuem, e sugerir ajustes necessários para aumentar a produtividade e a eficiência no atendimento e na área de vendas.

• Contribuir para que as políticas e os procedimentos da loja sejam cumpridos de forma a manter um ambiente de trabalho e de compras seguro e apoiar o treinamento da equipe para garantir os padrões da adidas e reduzir riscos.

• Supervisionar e apoiar as diferentes tarefas da loja (por exemplo, caixa, estoque e vendas), executando-as em conjunto com a equipe, se necessário, para garantir o funcionamento da loja e o atendimento ao consumidor.

• Liderar, motivar a equipe designada e apoiar o recrutamento e o treinamento de outros membros da equipe, fornecendo as ferramentas necessárias para ter performance e atingir os objetivos da loja, garantindo o engajamento dos funcionários, a produtividade e a cultura de alta performance, e liderando pelo exemplo enquanto defensor da Marca, demonstrando consistentemente a cultura para reforçar os valores da adidas.

• Apoiar o Store Manager no treinamento da equipe em todas as ferramentas e soluções de vendas digitais e omnicanais, além de prestar atendimento de pós-venda para garantir uma experiência de compra perfeita.

• Concluir todos os programas de treinamento aplicáveis, incluindo Foundational e Seasonal Brand, além de ter conhecimento sobre o produto, colocando o aprendizado na prática com eficácia.

• Trabalhar sempre priorizando a equipe, em total respeito com todos os colegas e contribuindo ativamente para tornar seu local de trabalho um ambiente inclusivo e acolhedor para todos.

Habilidades e Conhecimentos:

• Conhecimento de todas as ferramentas e processos operacionais da loja, do funcionamento da loja e de como atingir os KPIs.

• Compreensão dos padrões de Visual Merchandising para impulsionar a conversão através de ações estratégicas.

• Conectar, engajar e inspirar ativamente os consumidores.

title: Vendedor II - Food Service
description:
Descrição da vaga

Para nós da M. Dias Branco, a qualidade de vida no ambiente de trabalho, bem como, o desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional dos nossos colaboradores, são considerados fatores primordiais para o sucesso.

Dias Branco para a mesa de milhões de famílias brasileiras. Cada marca ocupa uma posição de destaque em seus mercados, conquistando diversos prêmios em pesquisas junto aos consumidores.

Realizar visitas e reuniões de alinhamento, apresentar o portfólio de produtos, negociar condições comerciais e desenvolver planos de negócio que impulsionem volume, rentabilidade e execução em mercado. Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (sell-in, sell-out, cobertura, estoque e mix), assegurando o cumprimento das metas e a correta implementação das estratégias comerciais. Fortalecer o relacionamento com distribuidores e clientes estratégicos, assegurando eficiência operacional, expansão de oportunidades e aumento de participação da marca.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Administrar contas-chave e distribuidores da região, garantindo performance e expansão dos resultados.
  • Realizar visitas periódicas, reuniões de alinhamento e acompanhamento in loco.
  • Apresentar portfólio de produtos, novas soluções e oportunidades de negócio.
  • Desenvolver e implementar o plano de negócio anual (JBP) junto aos distribuidores.
  • Negociar condições comerciais, políticas, verbas e ações promocionais.
  • Acompanhar KPIs de vendas: sell-in, sell-out, estoque, cobertura, ruptura e mix.
  • Garantir a execução das estratégias de preço, exposição e presença no ponto de venda.
  • Analisar concorrência, tendências de mercado e oportunidades regionais.
  • Realizar treinamentos para equipes dos distribuidores (força de vendas).
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e apresentar resultados para a liderança.
  • Prospecção de novos para garantirmos as metas, solicitada pela Cia.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio concluído;
  • Experiência comprovada em Key Account, Canal Indireto ou Gestão de Distribuidores;
  • Vivência no segmento de bebidas, alimentos, bens de consumo, Farinhas (Food Service);
  • Conhecimento de análise de indicadores, gestão por números e ferramentas de desempenho;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens e atuação em campo;
  • Domínio de Excel e ferramentas de CRM (diferencial);
  • No mínimo 6 meses de experiência na área ou áreas correlatas.

Será um diferencial se:

  • Pacote Office ou similares;

  • Técnicas de negociação.

• Licença não remunerada de até 12 meses uma pausa para você se dedicar ao aprendizado e desenvolvimento na sua área de atuação.

Financeiro - Benefícios que impulsionam seu bem-estar financeiro:

• Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR): Reconhecimento pelo alcance das metas estabelecidas.

• Previdência Privada: Possibilidade de reserva financeira com contrapartida da empresa, incentivos fiscais e opções de resgate ou renda futura.

  2. Etapa: Prova de Conhecimentos Gerais ou Específico
  3. Etapa: Entrevista com o RH
  4. Etapa: Entrevista com o Gestor
  5. Etapa: Contratação

Alimentar e inspirar as pessoas, transformando sonhos em realidade

Esse é o propósito que nos inspira e faz com que sejamos uma das maiores indústrias de alimentos do Brasil! Reconhecida como líder nacional nos mercados de massas e biscoitos, estamos entre as maiores companhias do mundo nesses segmentos. Com quase sete décadas de existência, marcamos presença em todo o País com marcas regionais, nacionais e, agora, no Uruguai, nossa primeira aquisição internacional! Com um amplo portfólio de produtos que são sinônimos de sabor e qualidade, temos uma relação de confiança e respeito com consumidores de vários perfis.

Atuamos nos seguintes segmentos: Biscoitos de trigo e arroz; massas de trigo e milho; farinhas e farelos de trigo; misturas para bolos; margarinas e cremes vegetais; bolos; snacks de milho e trigo; torradas; biscoitos cobertos de chocolate; pasta de amendoim; temperos e chocolates; molhos, granolas; cookies; panificação sem glúten e beneficiamento de grãos.

A partir da nossa sede, localizada na cidade de Eusébio, no Ceará, adotamos uma estratégia bem sucedida de construção e aquisição de novas indústrias. Possuímos um moderno parque industrial, com equipamentos de última geração, seguindo os mais rigorosos padrões de qualidade na produção de alimentos e operando com um modelo de integração vertical, que permite a produção de nossas mais importantes matérias-primas.

Contamos com mais de 17 mil colaboradores distribuídos em 21 unidades industriais no Brasil e 1 no Uruguai. Além disso, temos 29 centros de distribuição, estrategicamente instalados em diferentes Estados, que possibilitam a presença das nossas marcas em todo o território nacional e apoiando à exportação para mais de 40 países. Também negociamos ações no Novo Mercado da B3, bolsa de valores oficial do Brasil.

Valorizamos o respeito às pessoas e ao bem comum, considerando a diversidade como o elemento mais importante para geração de resultados e mudanças significativas. Buscamos construir um ambiente inclusivo, onde todos são respeitados, independentemente de idade, orientação sexual, gênero ou etnia. Todas as nossas oportunidades são acessíveis a pessoas com deficiência, e valorizamos a autenticidade e o potencial de cada talento.

title: Inside Sales Specialist
description:
Our future is yours!

Who are we?

We are Bridge Polymers, an international company with multiple branches across Europe and

beyond. We trade in polyolefins - something you’ve probably never heard of, yet encounter

every day. These are types of plastic with hundreds of different applications. Our customers use

these plastic pellets to create their products. Our suppliers are global producers of

petrochemicals, and we focus primarily on trading polyethylene and polypropylene.

Bridge Polymers has offices in several countries, including Spain, Poland, Romania, Brazil and

more, with our headquarters based in Eindhoven, the Netherlands. The market we operate in is

fast-paced. Thanks to our straightforward, honest, and down-to-earth company culture, we can

perform at our best even in the hectic world of fast trading. We are flexible and work with short

lines of communication, allowing us to always stay on top of the business!

Your responsibilities

Working at Bridge Polymers means working on your own future within a dynamic company. This

is especially true for the Inside Sales Specialist we are currently seeking. How your journey

unfolds and where you ultimately end up is largely in your own hands.

As an Inside Sales Specialist, you will receive a structured onboarding and development

program designed to help you quickly gain confidence in your role. From day one, you will be

actively contributing while deepening your knowledge in the following areas:

Business Development & Prospection

● Research new markets and identify potential commercial opportunities.

● Analyse import statistics and market data to uncover new prospects.

● Proactively engage with potential customers through calls, emails, and LinkedIn.

● Set up daily meetings with prospects to explore potential collaborations.

● Contact customers to understand their product requirements and gather relevant market

intelligence.

Sales Support

● Prepare, create, and send offers and proformas.

● Manage follow-ups to support the full sales cycle from lead to deal.

● Assist in applying for credit limits and monitoring customer credit status.

● Follow up on payments, required documentation, and overall deal progress.

Customer Administration

● Handle day-to-day communication with prospects and clients.

● Ensure all customer data, requests, and feedback are accurately documented and

managed.

● Support the sales team by maintaining a smooth and organized administrative workflow.

In short: an excellent career outlook - and it’s up to you to fulfil your potential.

Requirements

● You have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, International trade or similar field.

● You have at least 1–2 years of experience in a sales or business development role.

● Knowledge of import/export processes and B2B sales is a strong advantage.

● You are independent, ambitious, commercially minded, proactive, and able to perform

under pressure.

● You are fluent in spoken and written English and Portuguese.

● You are currently residing in Brazil, ideally near Blumenau and willing to commute to our

office.

What we offer

● Excellent employment conditions.

● Salary progression linked to your personal growth and performance.

● Mentorship from experienced professionals to support your development.

● The opportunity to be part of a dynamic, international team.

R$ 10.000 / mês (PJ)

title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
About the Company

Our client is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of two- and three-wheelers, with a strong global presence across more than 80 countries. In Brazil, the company’s strategic expansion in Latin America and is a rapidly growing multinational motorcycle manufacturer and distributor with annual revenues exceeding BRL 300 million. With operations spanning four key locations- they serve customers across all 27 federative units. As they continue to scale our team, dealer network, and market presence, we are building a high-performance, agile, and people-first organization, and are seeking an experienced HR Business Partner to support this growth journey.

Role Overview

The HR Business Partner (HRBP) acts as a strategic advisor to business leaders across Commercial, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Sales, Dealer Development, and Support Functions in Brazil. This role is responsible for aligning HR strategy with business objectives, driving people processes, and enabling a strong performance & culture framework in a rapidly growing market.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic HR Partnering

  • Serve as the primary HR point-of-contact for business leaders across Brazil.
  • Understand business priorities and design HR interventions to support organizational goals.
  • Drive workforce planning, capability assessments, and talent deployment strategies.

2. Talent Acquisition & Onboarding

  • Partner with global and regional TA teams to define hiring needs and support local recruitment.
  • Oversee onboarding and cultural integration for new hires in Brazil.
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian labour regulations during hiring and setup.

3. Performance Management

  • Drive annual and mid-year performance review processes.
  • Coach managers on goal setting, feedback, performance conversations, and development plans.
  • Support the implementation of global performance frameworks adapted to local needs.

4. Employee Relations & Compliance

  • Serve as the first point of escalation for employee issues, grievances, or policy clarification.
  • Ensure adherence to Brazil’s labour laws and internal policies.
  • Partner with legal advisors where required for sensitive ER cases.

5. Talent Development & Culture Building

  • Identify capability gaps and support local training, leadership development, and skill-building initiatives.
  • Lead cultural engagement programs in alignment with Client’s global values.
  • Support DE&I initiatives and cross-cultural employee programs.

6. HR Operations & Policy Management

  • Manage end-to-end HR lifecycle processes (payroll coordination, leaves, benefits, contract changes).
  • Collaborate with HQ in India for alignment on global HR processes.
  • Maintain HR data accuracy, dashboards, and workforce analytics for decision-making.

7. Organizational Development

  • Support org structure changes, role evaluations, job descriptions, and SOP creation for growing functions.
  • Lead change management initiatives during scale-up phases or new business launches.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s/ Masters Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or related field.
  • 5–10 years of HR Generalist/HRBP experience, preferably in multinational or high-growth organizations.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian labour laws and HR compliance.
  • Experience partnering with senior stakeholders and managing end-to-end HR processes.
  • Ability to work in a multicultural environment with teams across India and LATAM.
  • Fluency in Portuguese (mandatory) and English (strong proficiency required).

Key Competencies

  • Strong stakeholder management
  • Problem-solving & decision-making
  • Cultural adaptability
  • Communication & influencing skills
  • Confidentiality and integrity
  • High ownership and agility
  • Ability to operate independently in a startup-like environment

About Uitify

Uitify is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience;
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on cybersecurity trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.

Requirements

  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.

Why Join Us?

At Uitify, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

How to Apply

If you’re a product designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

title: Social Media Designer
description:
Portfolio Requirement: Must include illustrative work (e.g., campaign visuals, character design, infographics) as a core component.

About the Role

We are seeking an Art Director to join our Branding team and play a pivotal role in crafting creative ads and evolving the visual presence of our brand in Brazil. This position is crucial to ensuring that our campaigns are visually striking and culturally resonant, helping us establish a strong foothold in the Brazilian market. If you are passionate about creating captivating visuals and have experience leading high-level creative projects, we want to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

  1. Creative Direction & Illustration: Develop high-impact visual concepts for campaigns; Create and refine illustrations (digital/hand-drawn) that align with Brazilian cultural nuances and brand guidelines. Adapt global brand assets for the Brazilian market, infusing them with local aesthetic sensibilities.
  2. Campaign & Ad Creative Design: high-conversion ad creatives (short videos, interactive ads, H5 pages) using illustration as a primary or secondary element. Collaborate with content teams to ensure visuals are engaging and trend-aware.
  3. Team Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional teams to align visuals with brand objectives. Manage mid-scale projects from concept to production.
  4. Technical & Cultural Ownership Maintain visual consistency across digital, social, print, and OOH media. Stay ahead of Brazilian design trends (e.g., street art influences, vibrant color palettes) and integrate them into illustrations. Use design software (Adobe Suite, Procreate) and explore AI-assisted illustration tools (e.g., for rapid prototyping).

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of experience as an Art Director, Designer, or similar role in branding/advertising.
  • Portfolio showcasing: Illustration as a strategic tool (e.g., illustrated campaign assets, character design, data visualization). Proven ability to localize foreign brands for Brazilian audiences. Strong typography, layout, and color theory skills.
  • In-depth knowledge of Brazilian culture, aesthetics, and market trends.
  • Proficiency in design tools (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects) and project management.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in animation or motion graphics (e.g., illustrated explainer videos).
  • Familiarity with interactive design (e.g., micro-interactions for social media).
  • Understanding of user psychology in visual storytelling.

title: Venture Capital Analyst
description:
About Evvolve & Partners

Evvolve & Partners is a global financial and strategic advisory firm that connects visionary entrepreneurs with strategic capital. We support innovative companies in scaling through high-impact capital partnerships, leveraging our international investor network, deep market intelligence, and long-term value–driven approach. Our work goes beyond traditional capital matchmaking—combining proprietary sourcing, strategic insight, and a commitment to supporting founders throughout their growth journey.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly organized and analytically minded Venture Capital Analyst with a strong focus on developing investor-facing materials. In this role, you will craft, refine, and manage core content that supports our portfolio companies throughout their fundraising journeys—including pitch decks, one-pagers, and strategic narratives.

This position is ideal for someone who understands the venture landscape and excels at translating complex business models into compelling investment materials. You will collaborate with internal teams, portfolio founders, and design partners to ensure each presentation is both insightful and visually aligned with Evvolve’s high standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the creation, iteration, and finalization of investment materials (e.g., pitch decks, one-pagers, fundraising briefs).
  • Synthesize business models, market analyses, and competitive landscapes into concise and impactful presentations.
  • Collaborate closely with founders, internal deal teams, and design resources to ensure alignment in messaging, structure, and visuals.
  • Apply insights from investor conversations and market trends to tailor narratives for specific capital partners.
  • Ensure materials meet the strategic objectives of each raise while adhering to Evvolve’s brand and communication standards.
  • Maintain strong quality control and consistency across deliverables, often managing several projects simultaneously.

What We’re Looking For

  • 1–3 years of experience in venture capital, private equity, investment banking, consulting, or a comparable analyst-level role.
  • Strong proficiency in presentation tools (PowerPoint required; Figma a strong plus).
  • Clear understanding of early-stage fundraising processes and startup growth dynamics.
  • Exceptional written communication skills with the ability to synthesize complex ideas into compelling content.
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and capable of managing multiple workflows in a fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborative mindset and strong sense of ownership over deliverables.

Why Join Us

  • Join a mission-driven team shaping the future of venture capital and innovation.
  • Work with a global network of top-tier investors and high-impact founders.
  • Gain exposure to diverse sectors—from AI to sustainability to frontier technologies.
  • Play a critical role in the capital-raising process for fast-growing ventures.
  • Enjoy a flexible work environment with opportunities for global travel and cross-office collaboration.

  • Fidelizar os clientes atuais e prospectar novos, apresentando a Iguatemi, seus shoppings e oportunidades comerciais, a fim de trazer receita e 100% de ocupação para o shopping sob sua gestão;

  • Ter controle rigoroso sobre o fluxo de faturamento dos contratos do shopping, garantindo a menor inadimplência possível;
  • Manter o fluxo direto da informação/comunicação das suas atividades junto à gerência comercial regional, para garantir alinhamento de informações no mercado, evitando a sobreposição de negociações;
  • Visitar a concorrência local/regional, pesquisar oportunidades de negócio nos ambientes digitias (Instagram, LinkedIn, sites de varejo, etc) relevantes a sua unidade a fim de identificar clientes potenciais e se manter atualizado quanto às novidades do mercado;

  • Preparar materiais e apresentações para a diretoria e outras áreas conforme demanda;

title: Resource Manager, Professional Services
description:
Title: Resource Manager, Professional Services

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Department: Customer & Professional Services

Location: Brazil, Remote

About us

Graphic Communications, a CAI Division, is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for the print industy. Graphic Communications’ integrated and automated offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With over thirty years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the packaging and printing industries, it is the company's deeply held philosophy that they succeed when its customers thrive.

Position Overview

The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives. This role involves close collaboration with Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Regional Managers, the Sr. Director of Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales to efficiently manage resources, balance workloads, and ensure smooth project delivery.

Core Responsibilities

Resource Planning and Allocation

  • Identify, assign, and allocate resources to ongoing and upcoming projects based on skills, availability, and priorities.
  • Maintain a real-time view of resource capacity and project needs across the organization.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for project staffing and collaborate with Sales and Regional Managers to ensure proper coverage for upcoming engagements.
  • Own all new engagements at intake and assign resources based on availability and skillset.
  • Check in regularly with Project Managers to confirm they have the resources required for project success.
  • Maintain up-to-date skills and certifications records for all consultants. Forecasting and Talent Management
  • Collaborate with Sales, Project Managers, Regional Managers, and leadership to forecast future resource requirements.
  • Identify resource gaps and recommend cross-training, recruitment, or subcontracting needs based on upcoming opportunities.
  • Support long-term workforce planning and professional development of consultants.

Process Optimization and Tool Management

  • Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance.
  • Establish and enforce consistent processes for resource requests and assignments to maximize efficiency.
  • Ensure data and processes remain aligned across systems.

Daily Operational Responsibilities

New Engagement Intake

  • Review new projects pushed from Salesforce into Wrike.
  • Confirm all project metadata: customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts.
  • Confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created.
  • If automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data.

Assignment & Scheduling

  • Review unassigned Wrike projects daily.
  • Match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs.
  • Assign both primary and secondary consultants and confirm schedules with stakeholders.
  • Flag any assignment conflicts or delays to Regional Managers or Services Leads.

System Sync and Integration Oversight

  • Cross-reference Salesforce → Wrike and Wrike → NetSuite mappings to ensure accuracy.
  • Validate billing fields (sold-to ID, billing trigger, engagement type) and confirm correct syncing.
  • Ensure Concur sync processes are updating users, vendors, and expenses accurately.
  • Monitor Wrike integration logs and escalate issues as needed.
  • Maintain field mapping and oversee sync processes across Salesforce, NetSuite, and Concur.
  • Track and resolve open integration issues in collaboration with Operations.

Time Tracking Oversight

  • Validate daily timesheet entries for all consultants.
  • Identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries and follow up as needed.
  • Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers.
  • Ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing reporting.

Project Health & Status Monitoring

  • Monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.

Reporting & Communication

  • Participate in regular syncs with Regional Managers.
  • Track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations.
  • Respond to inquiries regarding capacity, project swaps, or timeline adjustments.
  • Provide data for utilization, staffing, revenue forecasting, and any other Professional Services metrics.

Performance and Collaboration

  • Monitor workload balance across consultants.
  • Participate in resource reviews with Regional Managers to support continuous development based on Sales forecast.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams to align timelines, priorities, and dependencies.

Qualifications

Experience:

  • 4+ years of experience in resource planning or operations within a software or technology organization.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and balance resources effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Skills:

  • Strong proficiency with resource planning tools (e.g., Wrike)
  • Working knowledge of JIRA, Salesforce, required, and NetSuite preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

title: Lead WordPress Developer
description:
Given that this position requires English proficiency, we are only considering CV's provided in English. Thank you, and we look forward to your submission!

About Olly Olly

Olly Olly is a $25M ARR digital marketing company serving small businesses across the United States. We've built our reputation on transparency, results, and making sophisticated marketing accessible to business owners who need to focus on running their companies, not learning marketing complexities. As we scale our platform and demand generation efforts, we're looking for an exceptional WordPress developer who can lead our landing page creation and optimization function.

The Role

We're seeking a battle-tested WordPress Developer & Landing Page Team Lead who has personally managed the technical execution of high-stakes marketing campaigns with millions of dollars in ad spend. This isn't a role for someone who's built a few landing pages—we need someone who has been THE person responsible for ensuring every pixel fires correctly, every form submits properly, and every dollar of ad spend has a clear path to conversion tracking.

You'll lead a team of two WordPress developers, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining the exacting standards required when significant marketing budgets are on the line. You'll be the technical bridge between our marketing campaigns (primarily Meta, but across various channels) and our HubSpot CRM, ensuring flawless data flow and attribution tracking.

Core Responsibilities

Landing Page Development & Campaign Execution

  • Design, build, and deploy high-converting landing pages optimized for paid traffic from Meta, Google, and other advertising platforms
  • Own the complete technical implementation of marketing campaigns from concept through launch
  • Ensure pixel-perfect tracking setup across all campaigns, including Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and retargeting audiences
  • Implement and troubleshoot complex tracking scenarios including server-side tracking, UTM parameters, and multi-touch attribution
  • Optimize landing page performance for speed, mobile responsiveness, and conversion rates
  • Conduct A/B testing and implement rapid iterations based on campaign performance data

HubSpot Integration & Data Management

  • Build and maintain seamless integrations between landing pages and HubSpot CRM
  • Ensure accurate lead capture, form submissions, and data synchronization
  • Implement and validate proper lead source attribution and campaign tracking in HubSpot
  • Create custom workflows and automations to support campaign objectives
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies and ensure marketing attribution accuracy

Technical Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and mentor a team of two WordPress developers
  • Manage workload distribution across multiple concurrent projects and campaigns
  • Establish and enforce development standards, quality assurance protocols, and best practices
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback
  • Create project timelines and ensure on-time delivery of campaign assets
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges

Quality Assurance & Risk Management

  • Implement rigorous QA processes, before any campaign launch.
  • Verify all tracking mechanisms are functioning correctly across devices and browsers
  • Maintain detailed documentation of tracking implementations and technical specifications
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they impact campaign performance
  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in all tracking implementations

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience
  • Direct experience managing technical execution of marketing campaigns with $1M+ in total ad spend
  • Must have been the PRIMARY person responsible for landing page build and campaign launch (not just a contributor on a larger team)
  • Portfolio demonstrating high-converting landing pages you've personally built and deployed

Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience implementing Git-based version control (GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket) and configuring Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for WordPress. Must be proficient in automating deployment across environments (Dev, Staging, Prod) and integrating unit and end-to-end tests into the workflow.
  • Expert-level WordPress development skills including ACF. Gutenberg, custom theme development, plugin customization, and advanced page builders (Elementor, Divi, or similar)
  • Deep understanding of Meta Business Suite, Meta Pixel implementation, and Conversions API
  • Proven experience with HubSpot CRM integration, forms, and tracking implementation
  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery, and PHP
  • Experience with VueJS is a plus
  • Experience with conversion tracking pixels across multiple platforms (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking implementations
  • Understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, and conversion optimization principles

Management & Communication

  • Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring developers
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high-priority projects
  • Clear communication style with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable with accountability when significant marketing budgets are at stake
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to marketing team members

Performance Standards

  • Meticulous attention to detail—one misconfigured pixel can cost thousands in wasted ad spend
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight campaign launch deadlines
  • Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues before they become problems
  • Commitment to continuous learning as platforms and tracking methods evolve

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketing automation platforms beyond HubSpot (Marketo, Pardot, ActiveCampaign)
  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies and tools
  • Knowledge of SQL for custom reporting and data analysis
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms (VWO, Optimizely, Google Optimize)
  • Understanding of SEO best practices for landing pages
  • Certifications in Meta Blueprint, Google Analytics, or HubSpot
  • Experience in agency or fast-paced startup environments

What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Audit current landing page infrastructure and tracking implementations
  • Meet with marketing team to understand campaign objectives and conversion goals
  • Review existing team workflows and identify optimization opportunities
  • Successfully launch first campaign under your management with zero tracking issues

First 90 Days

  • Establish standardized QA protocols and documentation for all campaign launches
  • Implement improvements to team efficiency and project management processes
  • Build trust with marketing team through flawless technical execution
  • Identify and resolve any lingering tracking or integration issues

First Year

  • Lead team through successful execution of major product launch campaigns
  • Demonstrably improve landing page conversion rates through testing and optimization
  • Establish Olly Olly's landing page function as a competitive advantage
  • Develop your team members' skills and create succession planning

Why This Role Matters

When we invest in marketing campaigns, every dollar needs to count. You'll be the person ensuring that our tracking is accurate, our data is clean, and our ability to optimize is never compromised by technical issues. Your work directly impacts our ability to scale profitably and serve more small business owners.

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus comprehensive benefits package. This is a full-time remote position, though you'll be working closely with team members across time zones.

Our Culture

We value directness, authenticity, and results over politics or polish. We're building something meaningful for small business owners who are often underserved by the marketing industry. We expect excellence but also recognize that real growth happens when people are supported, challenged, and given autonomy to do their best work.

Job Description

O Conversational AI Designer será responsável por desenhar, construir e otimizar agentes de IA (voz e chat) que interagem com usuários finais em casos de uso financeiros, operacionais e comerciais. É um cargo híbrido entre levantamento de requisitos, design conversacional e construção técnica do agente utilizando ferramentas no-code/low-code como ElevenLabs, ADI e plataformas de voicebots. Sua missão é garantir experiências conversacionais naturais, eficientes e alinhadas ao negócio, trabalhando em conjunto com POs, clientes e equipes técnicas.

Responsabilidades:

1. Discovery e levantamento de requisitos

  • Levantar processos, regras de negócio e necessidades do cliente;
  • Entrevistar stakeholders e mapear os journeys atuais (AS IS);
  • Analisar casos de uso, riscos, cenários críticos e métricas desejadas.

2. Design conversacional (Voz & Chat)

  • Criar fluxos, árvores conversacionais e intents;
  • Definir tom, personalidade e estilo do agente de IA;
  • Redigir diálogos naturais e eficientes (português/espanhol);
  • Estabelecer estratégias de manejo de objeções, quedas e redirecionamentos;
  • Validar a experiência conversacional em diferentes canais (voz, WhatsApp, web);
  • Apoiar equipes internas com ajustes avançados de lógica e estruturação de instruções do agente, garantindo clareza, consistência e eficácia nos comportamentos esperados.

3. Construção do agente

  • Implementar o voicebot/chatbot em ferramentas internas (ADI) ou plataformas equivalentes;
  • Configurar parâmetros, memória, contexto e comportamento do agente;
  • Integrar ElevenLabs para a voz do agente (TTS, sotaques, SSML opcional);
  • Realizar testes end-to-end e ajustar o comportamento com base em métricas reais.

4. Otimização e melhoria contínua

  • Analisar gravações, transcrições e dados de performance;
  • Ajustar instruções, lógica e fluxos para melhorar conversão e CSAT;
  • Garantir qualidade, consistência e cumprimento regulatório (quando aplicável).

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência prévia no desenho de chatbots ou voicebots (mínimo 1 ano).
  • Conhecimento em design de diálogos, UX conversacional e fluxos de decisão.
  • Capacidade de levantar requisitos diretamente com clientes.
  • Excelentes habilidades de redação e comunicação.
  • Espanhol nativo ou avançado + português intermediário (desejável).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA generativa (ChatGPT, LLMs etc.).
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com equipes de produto e desenvolvimento.
  • Conhecimento de ElevenLabs, Twilio, Dialogflow, Rasa ou similares.
  • Experiência básica com JSON, chamadas de API ou integrações simples.

Você tem o perfil para ser um Coru?

Temos a convicção de que o mais importante de Coru são as pessoas, por isso é fundamental que você faça um “Fit” cultural com toda a equipe. Estes são os pilares da nossa cultura:

title: Tax Lawyer
description:
Position: Tax Lawyer (Brazil) – Belo Horizonte

Location: Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais

Employment Type: Full-time

About Ax Legal

Ax Legal is a corporate law and advisory firm that supports international mining, technology, engineering, and industrial services companies entering and operating in Latin America. We work closely with clients from Australia, Canada, the United States, and Europe, helping them navigate the legal and commercial requirements of operating in Chile, Peru, Brazil, and across the region.

We pride ourselves on combining legal expertise with practical, on-the-ground support that allows our clients to run lean local operations while scaling effectively.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Tax Lawyer based in Belo Horizonte who will support our clients with Brazilian tax structuring, compliance, and ongoing operational needs. This position is ideal for a lawyer who enjoys working directly with international companies and providing practical, business-focused advice.

Key Responsibilities

  • Advise clients on Brazilian federal, state, and municipal tax obligations related to incorporation, ongoing operations, and cross-border structures.
  • Provide guidance on tax implications of service agreements, transfer pricing, international payments, and permanent establishment concerns.
  • Support clients with monthly and annual tax compliance, including coordination with accountants where required.
  • Review and prepare legal opinions, memoranda, and reports related to tax matters.
  • Assist with tax planning strategies for foreign companies entering Brazil or expanding their footprint.
  • Liaise with government offices, tax authorities, and regulatory bodies as needed.
  • Work closely with the broader Ax Legal team in Chile and Peru to ensure regional consistency for multinational clients.
  • Participate in client meetings, onboarding processes, and project planning to ensure smooth operations in Brazil.
  • Support general corporate or commercial matters when tax expertise is required.

Qualifications

  • Law degree from a recognised Brazilian university.
  • Specialisation or postgraduate studies in Tax Law highly preferred.
  • Minimum 4–6 years of relevant experience, ideally with exposure to cross-border matters or multinational clients.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian tax regimes, including  indirect taxation, corporate taxation and tax incentives.
  • Experience advising international companies is an advantage.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills both in English and Portuguese required.

Personal Attributes

  • Client-focused with a practical mindset.
  • Comfortable working independently while being part of a regional team.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple client matters simultaneously.
  • Proactive, organised, and solutions-driven.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to work with innovative international companies in mining, technology, and industrial services.
  • A collaborative environment with colleagues across Latin America.
  • Professional growth and the chance to build a long-term specialised career within an international practice.
  • Competitive compensation and flexible working environment.

title: City Manager
description:

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage!

Join us to witness the rapid growth of Meituan's global food delivery business and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (Python + React)
description:
About The Company

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

About The Opportunity

We're seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to join our Supply Chain & Operations technology team. This is a high-impact role focused on rapid application development for business-critical systems that power clients' global supply chain, logistics, and operational excellence.

You'll work embedded within a dynamic, hybrid team of internal engineers and external collaborators, collaborating closely with business stakeholders, UX designers, and technical leads to deliver full-stack solutions that solve real operational challenges. This role requires someone who goes beyond just writing code; you'll need to understand user needs, contribute to requirements analysis, and bring strong product thinking to ensure we're building the right solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop full-stack web applications using React/TypeScript (frontend) and Python/FastAPI (backend) to address operational challenges in supply chain, logistics, and planning systems.
  • Build and optimize solutions for large-scale relational datasets with MySQL or PostgreSQL, ensuring query performance and data integrity.
  • Deploy and maintain containerized applications on Kubernetes, implementing infrastructure updates, connectivity enhancements, and cloud platform improvements.
  • Integrate with third-party systems, external APIs, workflow platforms, and enterprise services (IAM, authentication, etc.) while upholding security and privacy standards.
  • Apply DevSecOps practices throughout the development lifecycle, focusing on security by design, automated testing, and quality gates.
  • Support and maintain production systems, including triaging and resolving bugs, implementing enhancements, and executing planned infrastructure upgrades.

Required Qualifications

  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Proven capabilities in backend development, focusing on Python with FastAPI in the backend , including RESTful API design and asynchronous programming patterns
  • Advanced proficiency in React and TypeScript for modern frontend development, Single Page Applications (SPA), including state management, performance optimization, and accessible UI design
  • Expertise in Vue.js, PHP/Symfony, and databases ( MySQL or PostgreSQL).
  • Disciplined approach to code quality and testing (unit, integration, end-to-end) with experience in Git

Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. Sobre a Empresa

A Alimak Group é um fornecedor global de soluções sustentáveis de acesso vertical e trabalho em altura para os setores comercial, industrial e da construção. Com presença em mais de 120 países, o Grupo desenvolve, fabrica, comercializa e presta serviços de soluções de acesso vertical e trabalho em altura, com foco em agregar valor ao cliente por meio de maior segurança, maior produtividade e melhoria da eficiência de custos.

O Grupo possui uma ampla base instalada de elevadores, elevadores de serviço, guindastes e plataformas temporários e permanentes, bem como unidades de manutenção predial em todo o mundo. O portfólio de soluções também compreende equipamentos de proteção contra quedas, medição e controle de carga, içamento e manuseio, além de um modelo global de pós-venda, com receita recorrente de peças de reposição e serviços, como inspeção, certificação, manutenção, reformas, substituições e treinamento.

Fundado na Suécia em 1948, o Grupo tem a sede em Estocolmo, 26 fábricas e unidades de montagem em 15 países e aproximadamente 3.000 funcionários em todo o mundo. Na Alimak Group, entendemos que nossos colaboradores são a chave para o nosso sucesso. Nosso objetivo é ser um Empregador de referência atraente, e nos empenhamos em atrair, desenvolver e reter pessoas qualificadas e motivadas, em um ambiente de trabalho profissional e atrativo.

Trabalhar na Alimak Group significa fazer parte de uma equipe de profissionais que trabalham juntos para promover inovação e as melhores práticas em soluções de acesso vertical.

description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

  • Desenvolver e implementar fluxos de automação inteligentes e agentes de IA utilizando a plataforma LangFlow e ferramentas similares.
  • Projetar e otimizar interações com Modelos de Linguagem (LLMs) aplicando técnicas avançadas de Engenharia de Prompt e Contexto.
  • Desenvolver e sustentar aplicações back-end robustas utilizando NodeJS e interfaces front-end modernas com ReactJS e NextJS.
  • Realizar customizações e integrações em plataformas de Inteligência Artificial corporativa.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação eficientes em Python e NodeJS para tarefas operacionais e de dados.
  • Integrar fluxos de IA com sistemas legados e corporativos (ERP, CRM) através do consumo e criação de APIs REST.
  • Modelar e manter soluções de dados utilizando bancos relacionais, NoSQL e bancos vetoriais para suporte às aplicações de IA.
  • Colaborar ativamente com as áreas de negócio para mapear processos, levantar requisitos e traduzi-los em especificações técnicas viáveis.
  • Executar testes contínuos (unitários e integrados) para assegurar a performance, segurança e confiabilidade das automações.

Experiência :

  • Experiência sólida no desenvolvimento de aplicações Full Stack com NodeJS e React/NextJS.
  • Vivência comprovada em projetos que envolvam consumo de APIs REST e integração complexa entre sistemas.
  • Experiência prática com análise de processos de negócio e tradução de requisitos para soluções técnicas.
  • Histórico de atuação em ambientes que utilizam metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Domínio de ferramentas de versionamento de código (Git/GitHub/GitLab).

Skills técnicos:

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em NodeJS (Javascript/Typescript).
  • Desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs REST.
  • Técnicas e metodologias de teste, incluindo BDD (Behavior-Driven Development).
  • Compreensão profunda dos princípios de Engenharia de Prompts para LLMs.

description:
Position Title: Wholesale Account Director (LATAM)

About GTT:

GTT is a leading networking and security-as-a-service provider for multinational organizations, simply and securely connecting people and machines to data and applications – anywhere in the world. Built on our top-ranked global Tier 1 network, GTT Envision is a single global technology platform to connect, orchestrate, virtualize and automate enterprise networks. Our portfolio includes SASE, SD-WAN, security, internet, voice and other connectivity options, complemented by professional services and exceptional sales and support teams worldwide. We partner with our customers to deliver Greater Technology Together. Learn more at

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute strategies to penetrate Tier 1/2 carriers & ISPs
  • Sell GTT’s international network services, including Global WAN, Ethernet, Direct Internet Access, IP Transit, SD-WAN, and MPLS.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with wholesale partners and decision-making units with significant international footprints.
  • Identify and develop new business opportunities from a standing start and revive dormant accounts.
  • Present GTT’s value proposition to prospects and customers through compelling proposals and presentations.
  • Manage the full sales cycle from discovery through development to close, ensuring timely execution and deal completion.
  • Collaborate with marketing and internal teams to maximize prospecting initiatives and accelerate pipeline growth.

Required Experience/Qualifications:

The successful candidate will bring a strong understanding of the LATAM wholesale carrier market, including the commercial landscape, pricing dynamics, and cross-border connectivity trends. Knowledge of major Tier 1 carriers and regional operators—such as Claro, Telefónica, América Móvil, and Millicom—is essential to identify opportunities and negotiate effectively. This expertise will enable the candidate to position GTT’s global network solutions competitively and drive strategic growth in the region.

  • 5–10+ years of experience in wholesale or reseller sales within the telecom or networking industry.
  • Proven track record of negotiating and closing deals with Tier 1 carriers, ISPs, and channel partners.
  • Strong knowledge of global WAN services, Ethernet, DIA, IP Transit, and related technologies.
  • Familiarity with sales methodologies such as SPIN, Miller Heiman, or similar.
  • Ability to engage confidently with technical topics and articulate complex solutions clearly.
  • Experience selling SD-WAN and security solutions.
  • Established network of contacts within the carrier and reseller ecosystem.
  • Candidates must speak, English, Spanish and Portuguese.

Vaga: Especialista Sênior em Entregabilidade

Estamos em busca de um Especialista Sênior em Entregabilidade para liderar a estratégia técnica de entregabilidade de e-mails marketing e transacionais.

Seu principal objetivo será garantir que nossos envios cheguem à caixa de entrada (Inbox), mantendo alta reputação, evitando filtros de spam e assegurando conformidade completa com os principais ISPs.

Você atuará diretamente na gestão de IPs dedicados, domínios de envio, aquecimento, autenticações, diagnósticos e resolução de bloqueios, sendo a principal referência técnica da empresa neste tema.

Gestão de Entregabilidade e Reputação.

Monitorar continuamente reputação de IP e domínio via Google Postmaster Tools, Microsoft SNDS e outras ferramentas.

Detectar e resolver problemas de bloqueio, incluindo análise e remoção de Blacklists (Spamhaus, Barracuda etc.).

Escalar o volume de envio com alta performance e estabilidade.

Garantir a aplicação rigorosa de boas práticas e políticas de cada ISP.

Infraestrutura e Governança Técnica.

Administrar e validar configurações de DNS, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, alinhadas aos requisitos de entregabilidade.

Atuar com MTAs e plataformas de envio como Amazon SES, SendGrid, Mautic, entre outras.

Realizar diagnósticos avançados usando GlockApps, testes de conteúdo, seedlists e ferramentas de monitoramento.

Apoio Estratégico Interno

Orientar áreas internas sobre melhores práticas para evitar filtros de spam baseados em conteúdo, frequência ou segmentação.

Produzir análises técnicas de engajamento e sugerir ajustes de rota quando necessário.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

Experiência sólida e comprovada como Especialista Sênior em Entregabilidade.

Domínio avançado de DNS, SPF, DKIM, DMARC e infraestrutura de envio.

Experiência profunda com ferramentas de envio/MTA (Amazon SES, SendGrid, Mautic etc.).

Vivência com ferramentas de reputação e análise como GlockApps. Capacidade analítica avançada para leitura de métricas e tomada de decisão técnica.

Inglês técnico para leitura de documentação e interação com suporte internacional.

title: Analista de Suporte de Sistemas SAP MM Pleno
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

  • Prestar suporte Nível 2 aos utilizadores do módulo SAP MM (Materials Management), incluindo processos de compras (Procure to Pay), gestão de stocks, MRP (Material Requirements Planning), GNF (Gestão Não Financeira) para contratos de compra e serviços, e gestão de dados mestre de fornecedores e materiais (Cadastro BP).
  • Investigar e solucionar incidentes e problemas funcionais relacionados com os processos de compras, gestão de inventário, avaliação de materiais, e dados mestre.
  • Realizar análises de causa raiz para problemas nos processos de requisição de compra, cotação, pedido de compra, entrada de mercadorias (MIGO), entrada de faturas (MIRO), gestão de stocks e inventário físico.
  • Efetuar configurações e ajustes no módulo SAP MM para atender às necessidades do negócio e corrigir falhas, seguindo as melhores práticas e a governança de TI.
  • Elaborar especificações funcionais para melhorias ou correções que necessitem de desenvolvimento ABAP, colaborando com a equipa de Nível 3.
  • Participar ativamente nos testes funcionais e integrados de novas configurações, desenvolvimentos e melhorias no SAP MM.
  • Orientar e apoiar Key Users e analistas de Nível 1, partilhando conhecimento e auxiliando na resolução de dúvidas sobre os processos de MM.
  • Manter a documentação dos processos, configurações e soluções atualizada na
  • ferramenta Jira e na base de conhecimento.
  • Colaborar com as equipas de projeto em iniciativas de evolução do SAP S/4HANA e sistemas satélites relacionados com o módulo MM.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos SLAs para atendimento e solução de chamados.

Requisitos:

  • Profundo conhecimento dos processos de negócio de Compras (Procure-to-Pay), Gestão de Stocks e Recebimento Físico/Fiscal.
  • Conhecimento em configuração e parametrização do SAP MM (ex: estruturas organizacionais de compras, tipos de documento de compras, determinação de preços em compras, avaliação de materiais, gestão de lotes, números de série).
  • Conhecimento em processos de MRP e gestão de necessidades de materiais.
  • Familiaridade com a gestão de dados mestre de materiais e fornecedores (Business Partner).
  • Conhecimento da integração do SAP MM com outros módulos SAP (ex: FI, CO, SD, PP, QM).
  • Conhecimento em Jira para gestão de chamados.

We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place. Who We Are We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. Job Description Your Career We are looking for a Manager within our Customer Success Engineering team. You will be responsible for managing a team of Customer Success Engineers (CSE) who enable customer success with our award-winning PANW portfolio. In this high growth business, scaling, optimization, dynamic spirit, and sustained performance are the essentials. As the CSE Manager, you will drive the team to in-depth knowledge of the indicators of success, utilizing data and your analytical aptitudes to guide changes, updates, and improvements. In this role, you will also work closely with the customer CISOs, security architects, security engineers, and development operations teams within mid-to-large enterprises, so you'll need to feel confident presenting implementation plans to all ranges of technical ability. Reporting to the LATAM Sr Manager, Customer Success for the technical services business, in this role you will lead a team of high performance Customer Success Engineers, distributed across LATAM. Your Impact
  • Customer escalation management, triage, prioritize issues, negotiate customer priorities, and manage expectations
  • Develop strong relationships with our sales team, customers, partners and internal teams (TAC, Product Management, Engineering)
  • Build and lead a team of Customer Success Engineers
  • Drive performance metrics - CSAT, renewal rate, upsell/cross-sell identification, reference-ability, adoption, consumption, and customer engagement
  • Ensure customers are maximizing their return on investment by implementing and operationalizing Palo Alto Networks solutions to achieve their objectives
  • Assist customers in implementing custom integrations and workflows into their SOC
  • Directly support customer requests, coordinate, and prioritize timely resolutions
  • Develop a comprehensive understanding of business challenges faced by customers and common objectives to appropriately map features and associated business benefits to address their needs
  • Serve as a customer advocate in influencing product roadmap and improvements
  • Ensure that engineers have the resources and processes necessary to confirm success and sustained performance through release cycles
  • Deliver guidance and direction to the team supporting goals and objectives, maximize engineer opportunity to exceed targets
  • Directly provide appropriate technical and soft skills training along with mentoring
  • Ensure that consistent and standard onboarding training programs are used and delivered effectively
  • Set team and individual goals in-line with overall organizational goals
Qualifications Your Experience
  • 8+ years of experience in Customer Success Engineering, Services Delivery, Professional Services, or Consulting
  • 3+ years of experience in people management role
  • Strong consulting and project management skills, with shown results working as a trusted advisor to drive business value for customers, including the ability to work well with client teams at different levels of technical and non-technical depth
  • Technical experience in networking or cyber security Industries
  • Public cloud experience is a plus
  • Consistent success working with customer escalations - assessing and communicating customer expectations and negotiating resolutions
  • Must be able to travel up to 30%
Additional Information The Team Our Customer Success team is critical to our success and mission. As part of this team, you enable customer success by providing support to clients after they have purchased our products. Our dedication to our customers doesn’t stop once they sign – it evolves. As threats and technology change, we stay in step to accomplish our mission. You’ll be involved in implementing new products, transitioning from old products to new, and will fix integrations and critical issues as they are raised – in fact, you’ll seek them out to ensure our clients are safely supported. We fix and identify technical problems, with a pointed focus of providing the best customer support in the industry. Our Commitment We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Analista de Redes e Telecom Sr
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027.

Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação.

Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência

Sobre o papel

Projetar, implementar, gerenciar e otimizar toda a infraestrutura de redes e telecomunicações, garantindo a disponibilidade, performance, segurança e escalabilidade das comunicações essenciais para as operações industriais e administrativas, bem como, identificar e solucionar problemas, propondo melhorias contínuas para a infraestrutura de redes e telecomunicações de TI e OT (Tecnologia Operacional) das plantas.

Atividades principais :

  • Projetar e implementar soluções de rede (roteadores, switches, firewalls, pontos de acesso Wi-Fi) e telecomunicações (telefonia IP, centrais PABX, links de comunicação) em ambientes corporativos e industriais;
  • Configurar e gerenciar redes LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPNs e VLANs, garantindo segmentação e segurança;
  • Participar ativamente da definição da arquitetura de rede visando a integração de redes de TI com redes de automação/OT (Operational Technology), garantindo a comunicação segura e eficiente entre os sistemas;
  • Monitorar proativamente o desempenho, a disponibilidade e a segurança da rede e dos sistemas de telecom;
  • Realizar análises avançadas para identificar e resolver problemas de conectividade, performance e segurança, minimizando o tempo de inatividade;
  • Gerenciar o tráfego de rede, otimizando o uso da largura de banda e priorizando aplicações críticas;
  • Auxiliar na implementação de políticas de segurança de rede, como controle de acesso, detecção de intrusão e prevenção de ameaças;
  • Realizar a gestão de ativos de rede e telecom, incluindo inventário, configuração e documentação;
  • Prestar suporte técnico de nível 3 para incidentes e problemas relacionados a redes e telecomunicações;
  • Realizar manutenções preventivas e corretivas em equipamentos de rede e telecom;
  • Assegurar a conformidade da infraestrutura de rede com as políticas de segurança da informação e as melhores práticas do mercado, implementando e gerenciar soluções de firewall, VPN e segurança de borda, assim como participar de auditorias de segurança, fornecendo dados e evidências da conformidade da rede;
  • Atuar como referência técnica para a equipe de TI em assuntos de rede e telecom, compartilhando conhecimento e orientações aos Analistas Jr e Pl;
  • Propor e implementar projetos de melhoria contínua, visando aprimorar a performance, segurança e resiliência da infraestrutura;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as novas tecnologias e tendências em redes e telecomunicações;
  • Outras atividades correlatas.

Qualificações :

  • Necessário formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Redes, Engenharia Elétrica/Eletrônica, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio de tecnologias de segurança de rede;
  • Noções de sistemas operacionais (Windows Server, Linux) e virtualização (VMware)
  • Conceitos de cibersegurança industrial;
  • Conhecimento em roteamento, switching, firewalls (Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto), VPNs e Wi-Fi (Cisco Meraki, Aruba, Ruckus)
  • Conhecimento em telefonia IP (VoIP, Asterisk, PABX IP) e sistemas de comunicação unificada
  • Conhecimento em protocolos de rede;

Habilidades Preferenciais

  • Desejável Especialização em : Segurança da Informação, Segurança OT ou Equivalente

Atuação: Inocência - MS

Residência: Inocência - MS

  • Liderar o desenho e a integração das arquiteturas de sistemas para suportar operações de front, middle e backoffice, bem como integrações com a B3 e outros participantes do mercado financeiro
